name_zh: 巴巴多斯/旅游/离岸金融：服务经济韧性与小国外交
name_en: Barbados/Tourism/Offshore Finance: Service Economy Resilience & Small State Diplomacy
description_zh: 巴巴多斯 米娅·莫特利 (1965-) 2018- 首位女总理/旅游/离岸金融/鲁姆/糖业/教育/医疗/2021 共和国/英联邦/气候/蓝色经济/布里奇敦倡议/债务重组/绿色债券/小国外交/联合国/英联邦/加共体/非洲/中国/美国/欧盟。核心模式：服务经济小国外交 — 旅游/金融/教育/外交/气候领袖/债务创新/共和国转型/性别/青年/数字化。体现 M212 服务经济小国外交 — 以"旅游金融双引擎+共和国主权+气候领袖外交+债务创新"四位一体，在小国/资源匮乏/气候脆弱/债务压力四重约束中构建服务经济韧性范式。
description_en: Barbados Mia Mottley (1965-) 2018- first female PM/tourism/offshore finance/rum/sugar/education/healthcare/2021 republic/Commonwealth/climate/blue economy/Bridgetown Initiative/debt restructuring/green bonds/small state diplomacy/UN/Commonwealth/CARICOM/Africa/China/US/EU. Core model: service economy small state diplomacy — tourism/finance/education/diplomacy/climate leadership/debt innovation/republic transition/gender/youth/digitalization. Exemplifies M212 Service Economy Small State Diplomacy — quaternity of 'tourism-finance dual engine + republican sovereignty + climate leadership diplomacy + debt innovation' building service economy resilience paradigm amid quadruple constraints of small state/resource scarcity/climate vulnerability/debt pressure.
reason_zh: 巴巴多斯非单纯旅游岛，而是"旅游金融+共和国主权+气候外交"三位一体小国强者。莫特利以布里奇敦倡议重塑全球债务架构，以共和国断殖民纽带，以气候领袖争大国话语权。M212 区隔于 M199 马来伊斯兰(文莱)、M211 狂欢节共识(特立尼达)、M204 气候生存(斐济)，核心在于"服务双引擎+主权断裂+气候话语权"的小国外交新范式。
reason_en: Barbados not mere tourist island but 'tourism-finance + republican sovereignty + climate diplomacy' trinity small state powerhouse. Mottley reshaped global debt architecture via Bridgetown Initiative, severed colonial ties via republic, claimed great power voice via climate leadership. M212 distinct from M199 Malay Islamic (Brunei), M211 Carnival Consensus (Trinidad), M204 Climate Survival (Fiji), core: 'service dual engine + sovereignty rupture + climate discourse power' new small state diplomacy paradigm.
